source: Root migrations 0001-0012 define the 55-table catalog and pre-REM-WP1.5 RLS baseline. REM-WP1.5 migration 0013 applies the full policy/grant rollout; actual-role verification passed in CI run 43683206104 on candidate d7fbf5851b11b07b65bde36f062db7b21f487947. The rls_current values below intentionally preserve the through-0012 baseline.

known_gap: REM-WP1.5's original 55-table scope passed candidate-pinned PostgreSQL 18 CI run 43683206104. REM-WP5.2 migration 0014 adds two tenant-scoped credential tables with their own FORCE RLS and app-role policies; those additions require candidate-specific migration and restricted-role validation before their rows are considered verified. The original 37 tenant-scoped, 3 read-only catalogue, and 15 control-plane classifications remain intact.
